title: Issuer-documented Visa test number, unseparated
rationale: The plain sixteen-digit form of a provider-documented test number: Visa prefix, 16 digits, check digit satisfied.

provenance.inference: Identity is structural (prefix, length, check digit). The provider documents it as a test number, so it is safe to publish; sensitivity describes the shape class. Authored by an AI agent run from the cited claims and case reasoning; no scanner output was consulted; unreviewed.

title: Issuer-documented Mastercard test number in groups of four
rationale: Serialization variant: four groups of four separated by spaces, the printed-card form.

provenance.inference: Mastercard prefix range 51-55, 16 digits, check digit satisfied; separators do not change the number. Authored by an AI agent run from the cited claims and case reasoning; no scanner output was consulted; unreviewed.

title: Hyphen-separated groups of four
rationale: Serialization variant: hyphen separators in form fields.

provenance.inference: Same value, query-string serialization. Authored by an AI agent run from the cited claims and case reasoning; no scanner output was consulted; unreviewed.

title: Final digit changed
rationale: One-property mutation of the Visa test number: the last digit is changed so the check digit fails while length and prefix are unchanged.

provenance.inference: Luhn sum computed by hand for the changed value is not a multiple of ten; a changed digit cannot be a valid number. Authored by an AI agent run from the cited claims and case reasoning; no scanner output was consulted; unreviewed.

title: Adjacent digits transposed
rationale: Deterministic mutation: swap the 12th and 13th digits (a 5 and a 4) of the Mastercard test number; the check digit detects the change.

provenance.inference: Luhn detects most adjacent transpositions; the sum for this value is verified not to be a multiple of ten. Authored by an AI agent run from the cited claims and case reasoning; no scanner output was consulted; unreviewed.

title: Visa prefix with fifteen digits
rationale: Deterministic mutation: dropping a digit leaves a 4-prefixed run of fifteen digits, a length the summarised Visa rule excludes.

provenance.inference: Visa lengths read as 13, 16 or 19; 15 is not among them (and the check digit also fails). Authored by an AI agent run from the cited claims and case reasoning; no scanner output was consulted; unreviewed.

title: Twenty-digit run
rationale: Boundary: the Visa test number with four digits appended exceeds the 19-digit maximum.

provenance.inference: 20 digits exceeds the 19-digit maximum summarised from ISO/IEC 7812. Authored by an AI agent run from the cited claims and case reasoning; no scanner output was consulted; unreviewed.

title: Sixteen-digit order number
rationale: Cross-family collision: a sixteen-digit identifier of a different family is the same length as a card but its check digit fails and it has no issuer prefix.

provenance.inference: Check sum of this value is verified not to be a multiple of ten. Luhn-valid non-card digit strings are deliberately not authored (they would be card-shaped under the repository safe-data rules); see the coverage notes. Authored by an AI agent run from the cited claims and case reasoning; no scanner output was consulted; unreviewed.

title: Thirteen-digit epoch timestamp
rationale: Cross-family collision: a thirteen-digit millisecond timestamp has the minimum length of the summarised card range.

provenance.inference: Check sum verified not a multiple of ten; also no issuer prefix. Authored by an AI agent run from the cited claims and case reasoning; no scanner output was consulted; unreviewed.

title: Test number under a non-card label
rationale: One-property twin of the plain positive: the value is the same but the label says tracking id. The shape still satisfies the card rules, so sensitivity depends on context.

reasons: Shape is a valid card number; the label suggests a different meaning.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: A context claim source for field labels (field-label context is research-needed).

provenance.inference: A label is context, not part of the identifier; no source states how labels change classification. Authored by an AI agent run from the cited claims and case reasoning; no scanner output was consulted; unreviewed.
